problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}5 & 20 & -10 & -5 \\ -2 & -8 & 6 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 & -9 & 12\end{aligned}].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
worked_solution:
Reducing $M$ to row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}5 & 20 & -10 & -5 \\ -2 & -8 & 6 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 & -9 & 12\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{5}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & -2 & -1 \\ -2 & -8 & 6 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 & -9 & 12\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & -9 & 12\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Note that we get ${a}_{22}=0.$ Therefore, we swap the $2$nd and $3$rd rows:

$$
\begin{aligned} & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 3 & -9 & 12\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & ↔{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & -9 & 12 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we multiply the $2$nd row by $\frac{1}{3}$ and the $3$rd row by $\frac{1}{2}$ to get

$$
\begin{aligned} & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 3 & -9 & 12 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{3}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & 0\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{3} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 4 & -2 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & -3 & 4 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
